en: A screw with threads spaced 2 millimeters apart requires less turning force to penetrate wood than a screw with threads spaced 5 millimeters apart.
Rubber tires on dry asphalt have a friction coefficient of 0.7, while ice skates on ice have a friction coefficient of only 0.03.
Earth's gravity accelerates falling objects at 9.8 meters per second squared, which is six times stronger than the Moon's gravity of 1.6 meters per second squared.
A neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight, whereas a standard ceramic refrigerator magnet can only lift about 10 times its weight.
A typical AA alkaline battery provides 1.5 volts of electrical potential, while a standard Philippine household wall outlet provides 220 volts.
Visible light wavelengths range from 380 nanometers for violet light to 700 nanometers for red light, making red light waves almost twice as long.
Sound travels through air at about 343 meters per second, but it travels nearly 4.3 times faster through water at about 1,480 meters per second.
It takes 4,184 joules of heat to raise one kilogram of water by one degree Celsius, but only 450 joules for the same amount of iron.
A one kilogram ball moving at 4 meters per second has 8 joules of kinetic energy, while the same ball at 2 meters per second has 2 joules.
A two meter crowbar with the fulcrum 0.5 meters from a rock provides a mechanical advantage of three, letting you lift three times more weight.
An incandescent light bulb converts only 5 percent of its electrical energy into visible light, wasting the other 95 percent as heat energy.
A whisper is 30 decibels and a rock concert is 120 decibels, meaning the concert sound is one billion times more intense than the whisper.
